Specification: This specification models a monotonic counter that uses the TLC-specific operators TLCSet and TLCGet to store and retrieve a worker-local value. The comments explain that TLCGet introduces nondeterministic behavior because it returns the local value of an arbitrarily chosen TLC worker, so the next-state relation does not correspond to a single consistent global counter behavior. The spec defines an initial state and a next-state action, then states a liveness property expecting x to remain less than 3 forever eventually, which is intentionally violated; it also includes a trivial leads-to tautology. The notable design point is that the module is specifically constructed to expose a TLC bug during liveness error-trace reconstruction when worker-local state is re-created with a single worker.
